The affix उरच् comes in the sense of 'having projecting teeth' after the word दन्त।

Terms: उरच्

The affix वलच् comes in the sense of मतुप् after 1. दन्त and 2. शिखा when a Name is formed.

Terms: वलच्

The affix दानीम् also comes after इदम् ending in the Locative -7th case, denoting time.

Terms: दानीम्

The nasal of 1. दंश् 2. संज् and 3. स्वञ्ज is elided before the गणविकरण शप् of the roots of the भ्वादिगणः (1st Conjugation).

Terms: Nasal Elision
